name: Rasputin Test App
tagline: A tiny echo server that proves your cluster can actually serve an app.
description: Not an app you keep — a diagnostic. It answers every request with the container's own view of the world: which node it landed on, the headers it received, the client address the request arrived from. Install it when something else is broken and you need to know whether the problem is the app or the path to it. Stateless, a few megabytes, no configuration, and safe to remove the moment it has told you what you needed.
postInstall: Open it. A page of plain text means install, DNS, the proxy and TLS all worked — the Hostname line is the container, and RemoteAddr is how your request reached it. Nothing to configure; remove it when you are done.

privilege.why: Runs with full container privileges so you can prove the consent path works — it is a diagnostic, not an app to keep.
